scope: Review-only v2 schema adjustment Template for the approved dots-lilac-bucket@v1 Artwork. The bucket hat, layer extraction, shape/color options, and recompositions do not inherit approval.

descriptionByLanguage.en: A light-lilac short-pile Dots orb wearing a yellow soft-fabric bucket hat, with no visible mouth or limbs.
descriptionByLanguage.zh-CN: 浅紫短绒圆球 Dots，戴黄色软布渔夫帽，无嘴与肢体。

artApproval.scope: This pending Template does not change the approved Artwork. All new body, hat, clothing and recomposed recipes remain pending.

identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One Dots character with one continuous short-plush body and two simple eyes. No arms, hands, legs, feet, mouth, screen face, props, or background.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个连续短绒身体、两只简洁眼睛的 Dots 角色。无手臂、手、腿、脚、嘴、屏幕脸、道具或背景。

semanticByLanguage.en: a round light-lilac short-plush Dots body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 浅薰衣草紫圆球短绒 Dots 身体

semanticByLanguage.en: a low three-lobed light-lilac plush cloud Dots body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 浅薰衣草紫低矮三瓣云团绒面 Dots 身体

semanticByLanguage.en: two glossy black upright oval eyes
two gently curved closed-eye marks as a static expression
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两道柔和弯曲的闭眼线，作为静态表情

semanticByLanguage.en: a broad ivory rib-knit lower-body wrap that visibly covers the lower third of the body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 宽幅象牙白罗纹针织下身衣，明显包覆身体下方约三分之一

semanticByLanguage.en: a soft yellow fabric bucket hat with a wide brim and visible stitched crown
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 黄色软布宽檐渔夫帽，帽冠缝线清晰

messageByLanguage.en: The bucket hat layer is fitted to the round orb. Use no accessory with the cloud appearance, or switch back to orb.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 渔夫帽配件按圆球外形制作。云团外形请选无配饰，或切回圆球。
